advice_items.quote: invest in I.T stocks early... Microsoft... 20 plus [years]
advice_items.summary_en: Invest in IT stocks like Microsoft early and hold long-term.
advice_items.summary_zh: 早期投资科技股并长期持有二十余年

advice_items.canonical_tag: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep
advice_items.quote: save your money invest don't spend more than you have have a diverse portfolio 401K never touch it
advice_items.summary_en: Save money, spend less than you earn, diversify, and never touch your 401(k).
advice_items.summary_zh: 量入为出积极储蓄，绝不提前动用401K

guests.first_money_or_break: 担任网络安全高管，并早期投资微软等IT科技股持有超过20年。
guests.zero_start_advice: 趁早存钱并投资科技股，不要超前消费，建立多元化投资组合，长期持有401K养老金绝不提前支取。

advice_items.quote: to walk away when someone didn't actually value my contribution... you are the value creation make sure you understand that that's who you are and that's what you're worth
advice_items.summary_en: Walk away when undervalued and recognize that you are the source of value creation.
advice_items.summary_zh: 不被认可时果断离开，认清自身的价值创造力

advice_items.quote: you've got to have leverage you've got to have the money to get there understand cash flow is King
advice_items.summary_en: Understand leverage, capital needs, and that cash flow is king when scaling.
advice_items.summary_zh: 规模化扩张必须懂杠杆、重资金且现金流为王

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.quote: you've got to have the ability to deliver on your service line and that's the only way you sort of hit that next level
advice_items.summary_en: Build strong service delivery capabilities to break through growth plateaus.
advice_items.summary_zh: 具备过硬的服务交付能力才能突破增长瓶颈

advice_items.quote: you don't know everything seek out advice don't try to be everything for everybody you're going to need help make sure you ask for it
advice_items.summary_en: Accept that you don't know everything, seek advice, and ask for help.
advice_items.summary_zh: 承认自己并非全能，主动寻求建议和他人帮助

guests.first_money_or_break: 在他人未认可自身贡献时果断离开，转型创业成为总部位于奥斯汀的全球化技术法律服务公司CEO。
guests.role_or_title: CEO of Technical Legal Services Company
guests.zero_start_advice: 认清自身作为价值创造者的定位；扩展业务要善用杠杆、资金和现金流为王的理念，确保服务交付；创业不要事必躬亲，要主动向他人请教和求助。

advice_items.quote: find a unique idea do something that hasn't been done
advice_items.summary_en: Find a unique idea and build something that hasn't been done before.
advice_items.summary_zh: 寻找尚未做过的独特创意并付诸实践

advice_items.quote: get the people around you that believe in it or get a partner
advice_items.summary_en: Surround yourself with people who believe in your idea or find a partner.
advice_items.summary_zh: 凝聚认同你愿景的人或寻找靠谱合伙人

advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.quote: it was working for myself I founded a company 20 something years ago and sold it when I was 33
advice_items.summary_en: Work for yourself and found a company to build sellable equity.
advice_items.summary_zh: 为自己打工并创立公司，积累股权价值

advice_items.quote: doing something that creates revenue for you when you're not actually working... as long as you've got passive income... you're going to do very well
advice_items.summary_en: Create passive income streams that generate revenue even when you're not working.
advice_items.summary_zh: 打造不亲自工作也能创收的被动收入体系

advice_items.quote: long-term real estate has always been a consistent good play but technology stocks and the stock market is still good
advice_items.summary_en: Long-term real estate is consistently solid alongside technology stocks.
advice_items.summary_zh: 长期投资房地产稳健，科技股同样值得关注

guests.first_money_or_break: 在谷歌出现前创立网站流量分析公司（Web trans），33岁时以10.3亿美元的价格出售后实现退休与财务自由。
guests.role_or_title: Founder of Web Analytics Company (Web trans)
guests.wealth_detail: Sold company for $1.03B ($1 billion 30 million) at age 33
guests.zero_start_advice: 寻找别人没做过的独特创意，联合认同你愿景的伙伴创业；建立无需亲自劳动的被动收入，并将资金配置到长期房地产和科技股中。

advice_items.canonical_tag: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep
advice_items.quote: I entered a profession that gave me a lot of job security I never lived beyond my means I was fortunate to make some sensible Investments
advice_items.summary_en: Choose a secure profession, never live beyond your means, and make sensible investments.
advice_items.summary_zh: 选择高稳定性职业，量入为出并稳健投资

advice_items.quote: first of all study it don't just do what the herd is doing
advice_items.summary_en: Study investing thoroughly before putting money in rather than following the crowd.
advice_items.summary_zh: 投资前先深入学习研究，切忌盲目跟风

advice_items.quote: Robin Hood Reddit and meme stocks that is just gambling which is very different from investing just go for the slow and steady
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid meme stock hype which is just gambling, and stick to slow and steady investing.
advice_items.summary_zh: 迷因股炒作等同赌博，应坚持稳扎稳打

advice_items.quote: you're competing globally and you're competing with kids who are actually going to sleep four hours a night... you've really got to be at it the whole time
advice_items.summary_en: In a hyper-competitive global market, you have to stay relentlessly at it.
advice_items.summary_zh: 全球竞争极其激烈，必须保持全天候拼搏

guests.first_money_or_break: 进入具有高工作稳定性的医疗行业（字幕识别为Madison），坚持量入为出并进行稳健投资。
guests.zero_start_advice: 投资前务必先做深入研究，不要盲从散户炒作迷因股或追逐泡沫市场；坚持稳健投资与量入为出，并做好面对全球高强度竞争、全力以赴的准备。

advice_items.quote: I bought a property over on Bee Caves 25 years ago that became very valuable
advice_items.summary_en: Buy property in promising areas and hold it long-term for appreciation.
advice_items.summary_zh: 早年购入潜力地段房产并长期持有增值

advice_items.quote: it takes time yeah I became rich but it took time that's an ingredient
advice_items.summary_en: Accept that building wealth takes time and patience is an essential ingredient.
advice_items.summary_zh: 积累财富需要时间沉淀，切忌急功近利

advice_items.quote: I took chances you don't accomplish anything if you don't take risks
advice_items.summary_en: Take chances because you cannot accomplish anything without taking risks.
advice_items.summary_zh: 敢于冒险抓住机会，不冒险就一无所成

advice_items.quote: learn from people that know what the hell they're doing
advice_items.summary_en: Learn directly from experienced practitioners who truly know what they are doing.
advice_items.summary_zh: 向真正懂行的人学习，汲取实操经验

advice_items.quote: make good connections too so that you become aware of opportunities
advice_items.summary_en: Build strong connections so you gain access to upcoming opportunities.
advice_items.summary_zh: 建立优质人脉网络，获取更多潜在机会

guests.first_money_or_break: 从事医药生物科技与商业地产行业，并于25年前购入奥斯汀Bee Caves房产，随时间推移大幅升值。
guests.guest_name: Austin Biotech & Commercial Real Estate Investor
guests.role_or_title: Pharmaceutical Biotech & Commercial Real Estate Investor
guests.zero_start_advice: 敢于承担风险去争取机会，但也要理解变富需要时间；想做房地产投资，要向真正懂行的前辈学习，并建立良好人脉以发现机会。

advice_items.quote: buying a home a multi-family home at a young age really paid off for me
advice_items.summary_en: Buying a multi-family home at a young age can pay off substantially.
advice_items.summary_zh: 年轻时尽早购入多户住宅，投资回报丰厚

advice_items.quote: find a financial advisor and have a financial strategy that fits you there's no one-size-fits-all solution
advice_items.summary_en: Work with a financial advisor to craft a personalized financial strategy.
advice_items.summary_zh: 寻找理财顾问并制定适合自己的财务策略

advice_items.quote: take more risks and worry less about the immediate and what people they're going to think about you... and follow your heart
advice_items.summary_en: Take more risks, worry less about immediate setbacks or others' opinions, and follow your heart.
advice_items.summary_zh: 多冒险少在意他人眼光，勇敢追随内心

guests.first_money_or_break: 担任奥斯汀市助理城市经理，并在年轻时购买了多户住宅房产（multi-family home），带来丰厚回报。
guests.role_or_title: Assistant City Manager for the City of Austin
guests.zero_start_advice: 年轻时尽早购置多户住宅，找专业理财顾问制定适合个人的财务规划；敢于冒险，不要被眼前顾虑或他人看法束缚，追随自己的内心。
